tags.name: Benefits
tags.description: Read-only health plans, retirement plans, and payroll benefit deductions.

tags.name: Custom Fields
tags.description: Company-defined custom fields for workers. Field definitions are administered with the workers:custom_fields permission; each field belongs to a worker-data category whose read/write grants govern its values.

tags.name: Departments
tags.description: Endpoints for department management. Create, list, and update departments within your company.

tags.name: Offers
tags.description: Endpoints for managing candidate offers. Create and send offers, list existing offers, and manage their lifecycle.

tags.name: Pay Rates
tags.description: Read regular and additional worker pay rates.

tags.name: Time Off
tags.description: Endpoints for worker time off management. See time off requests, which workers are assigned to which policies, or worker remaining balances.

tags.name: Workers
tags.description: Endpoints for worker management. "Workers" include anyone employed by your company, whether US or international, full-time employees or contractors.

tags.name: Workplaces
tags.description: Endpoints for workplace management. Create, list, and update workplaces within your company.

timeZone.description: The time zone that the worker is requesting time off in.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event was generated.
